title: Debug descriptor (<game>/kiln/state/debug/<windowsPid>.json), format 1
description: Written atomically by the native core (native/core/src/debug_descriptor.cpp) right after the .NET host started, only when kiln.json "developer_debugging" is true; one file per process, removed at a clean exit. It names the process and its control pipe; it proves nothing by itself: kiln debug (kiln_manage::debug) compares every field with what the process's own Windows side and its pipe answer before a debugger may attach. A file left by a process that ended is stale: its creation time no longer matches a running process.

sessionNonce.description: 128 random bits, new at every start.

windowsPid.description: The process id in its own Windows namespace (Wine's numbering under Wine and Proton).

creationTime100ns.description: GetProcessTimes' creation FILETIME (100 ns since 1601-01-01 UTC) as an unsigned decimal string, so no reader rounds it.

image.description: The process's image as QueryFullProcessImageNameW names it (a Windows path).

runtimeVersion.description: The .NET runtime the core loaded (the folder of its coreclr.dll), empty without one.

pipe.description: The control pipe: \\.\pipe\kiln-debug-<windowsPid>-<sessionNonce>; same-user DACL, local clients only.

elevated.description: The process runs elevated (native Windows; false under Wine).

managedReady.description: The .NET host had started when this was written; the pipe answers the current value.
